title: Helping a crying friend by about 4 years
summary: CDC says that by about 4 years, most children try to help a person who is hurt or sad, and its example is a hug.
body: The 4-year line is an action toward a friend, and the printed example is a hug. An earlier CDC age only records that the child notices distress. This later line is the attempt to make someone feel better. One hug is the illustration, not a required script. The series includes a child when three quarters or more show the behavior, and the leaflet is not a clinical instrument. A child who does not hug is not called unkind here.

sources.title: Milestones by 4 Years
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US government public domain. Supports 'Comforts others who are hurt or sad, like hugging a crying friend'.
